description: Source code implementing big number addition and subtraction functions for the BIGNUM structure in OpenSSL's BoringSSL library.

methods.name: BN_add
methods.description: Performs addition of two BIGNUMs, handling sign and magnitude.

methods.name: bn_uadd_consttime
methods.description: Performs constant-time addition of two BIGNUMs with normalized widths.

methods.name: BN_uadd
methods.description: Wrapper for bn_uadd_consttime that sets minimal width.

methods.name: BN_add_word
methods.description: Adds a word to a BIGNUM, handling sign and overflow.

methods.name: BN_sub
methods.description: Performs subtraction of two BIGNUMs, handling sign and magnitude.

methods.name: bn_usub_consttime
methods.description: Performs constant-time subtraction of two BIGNUMs with width checks.

methods.name: BN_usub
methods.description: Wrapper for bn_usub_consttime that sets minimal width.

methods.name: BN_sub_word
methods.description: Subtracts a word from a BIGNUM, handling sign and borrow.
